best.explanation: Molhe Leste looks like a small window for Too soft, Low confidence: 0-0.3 m, 29 kJ, 15 s period, lully 8/100, and 30 km/h wind may spoil it.  A jetty-shaped beach break with punchy rights and lefts; this is best for sheltered power when Supertubos has too much size; 14s+ at mid tide can produce heavy, powerful barrels at Supertubos / Molhe Leste.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; spot surf looks too small; wind is over 30 km/h; Molhe Leste looks below your bodyboard fun size.
best.shortExplanation: Molhe Leste is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  It looks too soft to make the drive worthwhile.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

ranked.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 130 kJ, 9 s period, consistent 72/100, and wind is the main risk.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: wind is over 30 km/h; wind fit is poor or too strong; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy; SwellMap rating 2/10 Poor — caution.
